node_definition.done_when: a test drives the reflex over a temporary crew home and finds: the resume ordering the reproduction found dispatches no review for the superseded head; a run with a live process dispatches none; a deferred run dispatches none until the deferral's instant, and one after it; a run that re-delivered after its resume dispatches one review, at the new head. The negative control reverts the repair of the path the reproduction found, and the first case then dispatches a review for the superseded head. A control that removes _resume_superseded_refusal itself does not count, because that guard already exists at base. The test files importing reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py , reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py or reckon/crew/resumption.py add no failure against a base arm. Both arms come from git checkouts under the run's own scratch directory, with the four follower variables unset, and run in place on the fleet node with pytest -n 8 . tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py passes at head. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings. Write paths: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py , reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py , reckon/crew/resumption.py , which records a resume's superseded head, if the cause lies there, and the new test.
